items.title: Treat dlt output as externally acquired observations, not facts
items.summary: dlt acquires and normalizes external records/claims. The ctrl graph no longer grants those records fact status at acquisition time; provenance, admission, correlation and qualification remain separate steps.
items.localContractImpact: Rename dlt graph/operation vocabulary to external observations and require admission before fact status.

observations.observation: dlt presents extraction, normalization and loading as data-pipeline operations; ctrl now preserves acquired record/claim status until epistemic admission.

claims.text: Acquisition adapters do not establish truth; dlt records require ctrl admission before any fact status.

items.title: Constrain how ctrl semantic identities enter OpenTelemetry carriers
items.summary: The new carrier policy separates semantic join identities from trace/span identity and denies baggage by default. Only explicitly admitted opaque identifiers may propagate; source text, credentials and large evidence payloads are forbidden.
items.localContractImpact: Add #CorrelationIdentity and ctrlTelemetryCarrierPolicy; apply it before StartObservationContext or telemetry export.

observations.observation: The OTel Python baggage API stores arbitrary name/value entries in Context, making an explicit ctrl propagation allowlist necessary.

claims.text: Semantic identity must be projected into telemetry carriers by declared policy rather than bulk baggage serialization.

items.title: Constrain P0 OTLP OTAP qualification to trace semantics
items.summary: P0 now compares a canonical trace semantic representation before and after OTLP -> OTAP -> OTLP while excluding Arrow physical layout. Metrics and logs are deferred.
items.localContractImpact: Keep the first executable transport witness narrow enough to establish semantic preservation without turning OTAP qualification into a generalized telemetry project.

observations.observation: OTel-Arrow defines OTAP as the column-oriented equivalent of OTLP with non-lossy bidirectional conversion and a physical representation based on multiple Arrow record batches.

claims.text: Trace semantic preservation can be qualified independently from Arrow batch layout and before metrics/logs are admitted to P0.

items.title: Separate monitor completion from executable qualification state
items.summary: The v2 evidence/report contract preserves terminal_success for the monitor loop while independently recording observation_only, executable_validated, or executable_failed.
items.localContractImpact: Prevent downstream consumers from reading successful publication as evidence that executable probes passed.

observations.observation: v2 run evidence records monitor_state and qualification_state independently; this run is terminal_success plus observation_only.

claims.text: Monitor completion does not imply executable qualification success.

items.title: Disambiguate authority revision from publication revision
items.summary: v2 report/evidence semantics use authority_revision for the pre-publication contract state. latest.json may separately record publication_revision as the manifest-seal commit, avoiding a recursive pointer hash.
items.localContractImpact: Replace ambiguous factory_revision naming in v2 outputs and make publication identity non-recursive.

observations.observation: The publication contract defines authority_revision as the evaluated pre-publication contract commit and publication_revision as the manifest-seal commit recorded by the later latest pointer.

claims.text: The run binds the authority it evaluated without recursively claiming the commit produced by latest-pointer publication.
